principle_violations.reason: The Order class is responsible for both managing order items and their attributes, as well as changing the order status. This violates the single responsibility principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Consider separating the order management logic from the status management into different classes, such as a class dedicated to order management and another for order status.

principle_violations.reason: The payment processing methods are not designed to be opened for extension without modifying existing code. Each payment method is implemented directly in their respective classes and requires modification for new payment types.
principle_violations.suggestion: Utilize the Strategy Pattern to allow for the addition of new payment methods without changing existing code. Create an abstract class or interface to define a standard structure for payment classes, allowing new processors to be added easily.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details above.
